note: produit de la cession du solde de la participation dans McAfee lors de la vente de McAfee à un groupe d'investisseurs non nommé (premier trimestre 2022) ; gain de 4,6 Md$
quote: During 2022, the sale of McAfee's consumer business was completed and we received $4.6 billion in cash for the sale of our remaining share of McAfee, recognizing a $4.6 billion gain in realized gains (losses) on sales of equity investments, net.
